nodes.label: Post.vert (shared post-process vertex shader)
nodes.rationale: One vertex shader shared by every pass of the bloom chain (BloomBright, BloomBlur x2, Composite) because all four draw the identical full-screen triangle-strip quad and only the fragment shader differs.

nodes.label: Three-stage bloom post-processing chain
nodes.rationale: The renderer's glow pipeline: bright-pass + downsample, two separable Gaussian blur passes, then composite onto the HDR scene. Named explicitly in every post shader's header comment.

nodes.label: Full-screen quad post pass
nodes.rationale: A single triangle-strip quad whose corners are already NDC (-1,-1)..(1,1), so gl_Position needs no matrix -- there is no camera or model in a post pass.
